title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
background: The Caroline Bezengi has been leaking crude oil since running aground in June 2026.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.
